subject: Invoice tax handling for BrightLabs — VAT ID validation & reverse-charge flow
messages:
From: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@brightlabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@brightlabs.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:05:22 +01:00
Subject: Question on invoice 4532 — VAT treatment

Hi Lukas,

Quick one from our AP team — we received invoice #4532 (attached) but our tax team flagged that the invoice lists Redwood US entity and applies no VAT. BrightLabs is an EU-registered buyer (HU VAT: HU12345678). We usually self-account via reverse-charge for cross-border B2B services. Can you confirm:

- Which Redwood legal entity issued this invoice?
- Do you have BrightLabs' VAT certificate on file?
- If not, can you reissue with our VAT ID in the invoice header and a reverse-charge note?

We need the corrected invoice to schedule payment this week. Attaching the certificate we use internally for your reference.

Thanks,
Anna Kovács
Head of Finance Ops | BrightLabs
[Attachment: BrightLabs_VAT_certificate_2026.jpg (JPEG, 42KB)]

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice 4532 — VAT treatment

Hi Anna — thanks for the quick heads-up and for attaching the certificate.

Short answer: we can handle this as a reverse-charge reissue, but need to confirm a couple of items before reissuing:

1) Invoice issuer: the original invoice was issued by Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) tied to your trial / hosted plan billing. For EU VAT treatment we can instead issue from our EU subsidiary (Redwood Inference EU S.à r.l.) to support reverse-charge.

2) We do need a signed VAT certificate or government-verified VIES lookup for HU12345678. Your attachment looks like the company registration page — thanks. Can you confirm the VAT ID shown on the certificate exactly matches HU12345678 and that the certificate is valid through 2026-12-31?

3) Please confirm whether BrightLabs prefers: a) a corrected invoice from our EU entity with reverse-charge wording and no VAT charged, or b) a credit note from the US invoice and a fresh EU-issued invoice. Our finance team prefers the credit + reissue route for clean records, but we can proceed with either.

I'll loop in Mina (tax ops) and Marcus (billing) to coordinate the reissue and payment timing to avoid delaying your payment window.

Regards,
Lukas Meyer
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_invoice_4532_202611.pdf (PDF, 128KB)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@brightlabs.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 07:44:10 -08:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice 4532 — VAT treatment

Thanks, Lukas. Quick tax ops note:

- If BrightLabs is a validated EU VAT-registered entity (HU12345678) and the supply is B2B digital services, reverse-charge applies and our EU entity should issue the invoice with the following statement on the invoice: "VAT reverse-charged under Article 194 VAT Directive — recipient to account for VAT."
- We require a VIES confirmation screenshot or an official VAT registration certificate. The JPEG Anna attached is acceptable if it is an official certificate showing the registration and expiry.
- For accounting clarity: best practice is to issue a credit against the US invoice and create a new invoice from Redwood Inference EU S.à r.l.; this keeps the tax ledgers neat and supports audit trails.

Marcus, can you draft the credit + EU reissue? Rachel, flag any FX/payment implications for AP. Anna — if you can reply with a short confirmation that HU12345678 is active (or paste the VIES lookup URL), we'll action this today and push the updated invoice to the DocuSign/HubSpot billing link for signature if needed.

— Mina
Tax Operations | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: payment_plan_draft.docx (DOCX, 14KB)]

From: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@brightlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: billing@brightlabs.com
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:02:44 +01:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice 4532 — VAT treatment

Thanks Mina — confirmed: HU12345678 is active. VIES lookup: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/vatResponse.html?memberStateCode=HU&number=12345678 (screenshot attached).

We prefer option (b) credit + EU reissue for our GL. Please issue the credit and reissue from Redwood Inference EU S.à r.l. with the reverse-charge statement. Also note: BrightLabs pays via SEPA for EU invoices — please include our IBAN on the new invoice and set the payment term to 14 days.

Anna
[Attachment: VIES_screenshot_HU12345678.png (PNG, 56KB)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Kovács <anna.kovacs@brightlabs.com>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Question on invoice 4532 — VAT treatment

Hi Anna — we processed the credit note for invoice #4532 and reissued invoice #4532-EU from Redwood Inference EU S.à r.l. The new invoice includes:

- Buyer VAT: HU12345678
- Reverse-charge statement: "VAT reverse-charged under Article 194 VAT Directive — recipient to account for VAT."
- Payment method: SEPA (IBAN: HU12 3456 7890 1234 5678 9012)
- Net amount unchanged; no VAT applied
- Payment term: 14 days from invoice date

Attachments: Redwood_invoice_4532_202611.pdf (credit note) and Redwood_invoice_4532-EU_202611.pdf (new EU invoice).

We also uploaded the documents to the HubSpot billing record and to DocuSign for signature if you need an authorized invoice copy. Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/contact/4532

Let us know once payment is scheduled and we'll mark the account to avoid duplicate dunning. Apologies for the friction — thanks for moving fast on the VIES confirmation.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
